name: Hunters Jacket (Island Green)
desc: The Hunters Jacket brings the classic jackets worn by American hunters back in the ’50s and ’60s right up to date. Rugged luxury is maybe how we’d describe this. The hardy twill fabric means it’s reassuringly tough, while that contrasting cord collar gives it a nice and sophisticated feel. Combine that with a chunky YKK zip and fleece-lined hand pockets and you’re all set.
reason: A relaxed olive cotton jacket, close in spirit to the 18 East Siello Utility Jacket you saved.

name: Work Pant ~ Ivy Green
desc: The Work Pant features a wide leg fit and high rise reminiscent of classic work pants. We chose a heavyweight chino fabric with a pronounced twill weave that is structured yet drapes well. After sewing, the pants are garment dyed and rinsed for a broken in feel. The pant is finished with double needle flat fell seams throughout for extra durability and tonal dyed corozo buttons.
reason: A wide-leg green cotton work pant, in the same loose, roomy spirit as the 18 East Civilita Cargo Pant you saved.

name: Papery Lantern Trouser, Olive
desc: A wide leg trouser crafted from lightweight papery cotton in olive. Featuring a relaxed silhouette with softly curved volume through the leg, front pleats, and an easy drape, the shape balances structure with movement. Finished with side seam pockets, back patch pockets, belt loops, and a zip fly with button closure. Christopher is 6'4" and typically wears a size Large in tops and 34 in bottoms. They're wearing the size Large here for a relaxed fit.
reason: A wide, pleated olive trouser in papery cotton, echoing the easy cargo shape of the Civilita Pant you saved.

name: Utility Flannel ~ Espresso Twill Check
desc: Featuring matching front chest pockets and a straight back yoke, the Utility Flannel is a classic workwear silhouette with a modern fit. This flannel body is slightly cropped and more generous in the chest than our Crosscut body. This fabric is custom woven for us to have a raised diagonal twill pattern and a subtle window check pattern that give the shirt dynamic texture. The fabric has been brushed on the inside for comfort. The shirt is finished with natural corozo fisheye buttons that reference vintage workwear trims.
reason: A brown twill check shirt cut generous through the chest, textured like the Indi + Ash George Coat you saved.

name: Tucking Stripe Wool Cotton Sweater | Green Multi
desc: Dropped shoulders complement the boxy shape of our sweater. Knitted from a wool and cotton blend with tuck-stitched stripes and finished with a stand collar. Soft yarns are liable to pill to some extent, even when using those of the best quality. To take good care of them remove any pills using a pilling comb and protect them from sharp items or jewellery that may catch or snag.
reason: An oversized wool sweater with tuck-stitched stripes in green, in the same textured-knit spirit as the Chet knit tee you saved.

name: Mini Hoodie, Pigment Elm
desc: A cropped, boxy hoodie with a high crossover collar that reframes a familiar silhouette with a more sculptural edge, featuring dropped shoulders, a shortened body, and gusseted side panels for ease and structure, cut from a lightweight looped French terry that is softly brushed for a smooth hand, with a kangaroo pocket and clean, stringless hood that keeps the shape considered and pared back, and finished with pigment dyeing that brings subtle variation and depth across the surface over time. Chukwuma is 6'0" and typically wears a size Large in tops.
details: Machine wash cold, lay flat to dry
reason: A relaxed, boxy cropped hoodie in a warm earthy tone, close to the Ragged Thermal Hoodie you saved.

name: Short sleeve polo in navy blue perforated stripe linen
desc: "The Casa Isaac label on this piece lets you know there's something special going on. It's a small collection we adore from GRP that introduces a folksy, rustic point of view to the design. The linen knit has a dry, crepe-y texture that wears like a dream in warmer temps." ---Ludwin Ribbed hem and cuffs; two button placket with horn buttons We recommend taking your usual size per the size conversion
reason: A breathable linen polo, good for dancing or travel, close in texture to the Chet knit tee you saved.

name: 13.5 oz Loose Fit Jeans - Indigo
desc: The Loose Fit from Omoto is a great wide leg jean with a high rise, a roomy top block, and a comfortable straight-leg. They're a super classic 5-pocket jean, with all the right details: copper rivet reinforcements (including hidden ones on the back pockets), heavy-duty chainstitch construction, custom iron button-fly, and selvedge ID details on the outseam and beneath the coin pocket.
reason: The wide-leg loose fit jean he already has, now in indigo, roomy through the top block and good for dancing.
